episodes.synopsis: After finishing the greatest battle in Exgate Online history, the player gets incarnated as his character.
episodes.title: A Wild Last Boss Appears!

episodes.synopsis: Lufas journeys to Svel and learns about what happened to the world in her 200 year absence.
episodes.title: We Came to Svel!

episodes.synopsis: Aries attacks Svel, fighting Megrez and Levia.
episodes.title: Aries Has Attacked!

episodes.synopsis: After beating sense into Aries, Lufas punishes the devilfolk that manipulated him and catches up with Megrez.
episodes.title: They Were Pulling Strings Behind the Scenes!

episodes.synopsis: Lufas creates an RV golem and enjoys a hot spring with Dina. Then they brave Lufas' grave.
episodes.title: A Wild Hot Spring Appeared!

episodes.synopsis: Lufas recovers Libra, leaving Jean's party believing they conquered the Grave of the Black-Winged King.
episodes.title: Libra of the Scales Appeared!

episodes.synopsis: Lufas takes a pit-stop at the new home of her people and memories resurface. Libra & Aries each uncover a foe.
episodes.title: I was... a Savior!

episodes.synopsis: Tensions in Gjallarhorn are verging on civil war as Lufas debates what to do. Libra grows suspicious of Dina.
episodes.title: Hey! 5%?! Seriously?!

episodes.synopsis: Libra captures Jupiter, Lufas stops Aigokeros, and Dina calms the populace. Afterward, Merak get a pep-talk.
episodes.title: The Masses Have Rioted!

episodes.synopsis: The truth about Dina comes to light and she comes to blows with Lufas. Is she really telling the truth though?
episodes.title: Who Are You?

episodes.synopsis: The true Hero is summoned to defeat the Devil King! Yet his journey starts with encountering both Last Bosses!
episodes.title: A Wild Lufas Maphaal And a Wild Devil King Have Appeared at the Same Time!!!

episodes.synopsis: At her homeland Lufas uncovers the reason for Parthenos' actions and hints to the real Lufas' true goals.
episodes.title: There Was Something Incredible in My Homeland!
